name: Food Stall Promenade
description: The Food Stall Promenade is a lively corridor of clan kitchens, spice vendors, tasting counters, and artisan food stalls. Aromas fill the air as cooks prepare traditional Vah Shir dishes, caravan delicacies, and ceremonial meals. Market Sentinels maintain order while crowds gather for food, trade, and social exchange.
